decisions.reason: A burner component extends the core radiant-heater line, costs little to keep available, and its value is still being revealed through the installed base, so the option stays open.
Electric infrared panels hedge against the shift away from gas heating, demand is still uncertain, and keeping a product with its own web page is cheap, so the option is retained.
The halogen infrared heater widens the electric portfolio for outdoor and spot heating at low holding cost, and one year of results is too early to judge, so it is kept.
The industrial electric hall heater sits close to the core offer and the electrification trend, so its upside remains open and keeping it is cheap.

The hydrogen-capable dark heater went into real operation in January 2023 and matches the firm's lower-carbon strategy, so this high-uncertainty, high-value option should be kept and developed further.
